purpose: P3 iteration 4 (REVIEW-ITERATION-3.md F1/F2/F7): which musical rates the light and the music carry, BOOM 55.5-75 s
disclosure: Frozen before the lane's own iteration-4 run, but AFTER the reviewer's rate-share numbers (REVIEW-ITERATION-3.md F1) were read. The criterion is therefore not blind to those numbers; the planted synthetic check is what makes it falsifiable.

rate_share.method: Welch PSD, Hann, 8 s segments, 50% overlap, linear detrend per segment, nfft = 8 x segment (zero-padded, 0.0156 Hz grid at any rate); share = power within +/-0.06 Hz of the rate / power in 0.3-5.0 Hz
rate_share.primary_pre_detrend: none (a 1 s moving-mean detrend keeps only ~21% of the bar-rate power and ~79% of the beat-rate power, so it biases against the bar)
rate_share.secondary_pre_detrend: 1 s edge-padded moving mean (p3_q3_alignment.detrend), reported for comparison with the reviewer

comb_scan.periods_s: 0.300 to 0.655 in 0.005 s steps (72 trial periods)
comb_scan.score: mean ACF at k*P minus mean ACF at (k+0.5)*P, k = 1..4, ACF linearly interpolated between samples

beat_present_criterion: comb-scan best period within 0.425-0.445 s AND primary beat-rate share >= 0.08

planted_check.synthetic: 19.5 s at the series' own rate: 3+3+2 accent impulses (eighths 0,3,6 of each 138 BPM bar, amplitude 1) plus every eighth at 0.25, each convolved with exp(-t/0.08 s); plus white noise (std 0.5 x accent std) and a 0.05 Hz drift; seed 404
planted_check.with_beat: add a 2.30 Hz sinusoid of amplitude 0.6 x accent std -> beat_present must be true
planted_check.without_beat: no sinusoid -> beat_present must be false
planted_check.rc: exit 1 if any planted case is wrong; a recorded red run swaps the with-beat signal for the without-beat one
